title: GPT-5 Turbo Released: 40% Cheaper API, 256K Context, Real-Time Video
excerpt: OpenAI just launched GPT-5 Turbo with significant improvements.
content:
## GPT-5 Turbo is Here

On June 5, 2026, OpenAI officially released GPT-5 Turbo.

### 256K Context
Doubles the context window from 128K to 256K tokens.

### 3x Faster
Architectural optimizations make it 3x faster than GPT-5.

### 40% Price Cut
Input $1.50/M tokens, Output $6/M tokens.
